verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API with human-readable reference pages (rollbar-docs-14, rollbar-docs-15), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate (rollbar-probe-2). The llms.txt file and the MCP server are documentation and tool access, not an API specification, so they do not satisfy this story.
